blurb: Guests participate in a hot air balloon flight lasting about 45 minutes to an hour, floating smoothly with the wind and experiencing panoramic views. Flights include a pre-flight briefing, inflation process, and a post-flight reception with light refreshments and traditional champagne ceremony. Flights are offered twice daily, year-round, weather permitting, from select launch sites determined by wind conditions.
extraNote: Flights are weather permitting; safety is top priority · Flights may be rescheduled due to inclement weather but not refunded · Reservation required; call to book · Currently meet at Kwik Trip in New Richmond WI; launch site varies by wind conditions and is informed at check-in. · Year round, 7 days a week, weather permitting
